title: The Season of Release
style: cinematic pop, 96 BPM, harvest metaphor, patient creator theme, male vocal warm and certain, the moment of release after a long hold, ENAMOUR vault opening, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
The farmer doesn't apologise
For not harvesting in winter
The artist doesn't apologise
For the years between the timber
Everything grows in its season
Everything breaks at the right time
Everything holds until it's ready
Everything falls into rhyme

[CHORUS]
The season of release
Has finally arrived
The season of release
The vault that survived
Thirty years in the ground
Now breaking through
The season of release
February 24 — the cue

[VERSE 2]
ENAMOUR: INSPIRE
The French word for love
To inspire with love
Not below — above
30 songs — 30 years — 30 chances
Every one of them now dances
The season came — vault opened
The season of release — unbroken

[OUTRO]
The season. Of release. Is now.
